name: Hanoi to Sapa
summary: Sapa is a night train to Lao Cai, then the climb, or a bus into town. The bus is 5–6 hours on one page and 5–7 hours on another. Minutes on the road up from Lao Cai are Check on arrival.

modes.duration: Night trains to Lao Cai. The climb is Check on arrival.
modes.note: From 10 October 2026 the night trains are SP15 21:45–05:20, SP3 22:00–05:50, and SP7 22:40–06:27. A 2015 board still prints SP1 21:40–05:30 and SP3 22:00–06:10. That is not this board. Fares are Check on arrival. The train ends at Ga Lào Cai.
Vietnam Tourism prints 5–6 hours into the center. The Hoang Lien center page prints 5–7 hours. Both stay.

seoTitle: Hanoi to Sapa — train, bus, and the Lao Cai transfer
seoDescription: Overnight train versus limousine bus from Hanoi to Sapa, and where each one actually stops.

faqs.q: Does the train go to Sapa?
faqs.a: It goes to Lao Cai. A bus or taxi climbs to Sapa from there.
